context: The plugin's data source is the literal 'claims' array passed in the input; no external service or file lookup is required. All amounts are integer cents. For each claim independently: total_billed is the sum of all line billed_cents and total_allowed is the sum of all line allowed_cents; lines may be empty, and billed-minus-allowed never affects the allocation. Health remaining_deductible = max(deductible_cents - deductible_used_cents, 0), while auto remaining_deductible is exactly deductible_cents (auto requires deductible_used_cents = 0 and coinsurance_bps = 0). deductible_share = min(total_allowed, remaining_deductible). coinsurance = half-up to the nearest integer cent of (total_allowed - deductible_share) * coinsurance_bps / 10000, rounded only once at the claim level; this is equivalent to (base*bps + 5000)//10000. insurer_before_limit = total_allowed - deductible_share - coinsurance. insurer = min(insurer_before_limit, limit_cents); limit_reduction = insurer_before_limit - insurer. patient = total_allowed - insurer (deductible, coinsurance and any cap shift are all patient-paid, and insurer + patient must equal allowed). Submit exactly one allocation per input claim with all ten integer fields; output order is irrelevant, but claim_id must match the source and every monetary component is independently verified.
